method: RE-SCORING ONLY. Pure arithmetic on stored dayDump records. No re-solve, no DB, no RNG, no network.

rulerDefs.A: SHIPPING dayTolerance (mealSolver.js:229). fat band +-0.25*fatMid outside [fatLo,fatHi]; carb band, keto over-allowance 0.
rulerDefs.B: FAT FLOOR ONLY: fat >= round(0.30*lbmLb), no fat ceiling. Carb as A.
rulerDefs.C: CARB FLOOR ONLY: carb >= carbLo (no slack), no non-keto ceiling, keto ceiling retained. Fat as A.
rulerDefs.D: FULL FLOOR RULER = B's fat term AND C's carb term (reproduces W1-2's Ruler D).
rulerDefs.E35: A's fat FLOOR, fat CEILING re-anchored to 35%E of targetKcal (AMDR). Carb as A.
rulerDefs.E30: A's fat FLOOR, fat CEILING re-anchored to 30%E of targetKcal (Helms). Carb as A.
rulerDefs.F: A with the non-keto carb LOW bound repaired to max(carbLo-0.25*carbMid, 50) = the engine's own NONKETO_CARB_FLOOR_G. Strict tightening.
rulerDefs.F*: F, but the repaired floor is clamped to carbHi so the band is never empty.
rulerDefs.R35: W2-6 RECOMMENDED INSTRUMENT: fat >= 0.30*lbm AND fat <= 35%E; carb >= max(carbLo,50) non-keto / carbLo keto; keto ceiling hard; no non-keto carb ceiling.
rulerDefs.R30: R35 with the fat ceiling at 30%E (Helms).
rulerDefs.R35c: R35 but keeping A's non-keto carb CEILING (isolates the carb-ceiling share of R35).
rulerDefs.E35k: E35 WITH A KETO CARVE-OUT: non-keto fat ceiling = 35%E (AMDR); keto keeps A's fat band. Carb as A.
rulerDefs.R35k: R35 WITH A KETO CARVE-OUT — THE PRICED RECOMMENDATION: fat >= 0.30*lbm; non-keto fat ceiling 35%E, keto keeps A's; carb >= max(carbLo,50) non-keto; keto ceiling hard; no non-keto carb ceiling.
rulerDefs.R35k+cc: R35k but keeping A's non-keto carb CEILING.
rulerDefs.R40k: R35k at the MEASURED BREAK-EVEN ceiling of 40%E instead of AMDR's 35%E — shown to price the nutrition/compliance trade, not recommended.
rulerDefs.A15: A with the fat allowance widened to +-0.50*fatMid (brief C9 / scoreDays --ruler=fatwide:0.5). BOTH sides widen.
rulerDefs.A15c: A with the carb allowance widened to +-0.50*carbMid (keto over-allowance stays 0).
rulerDefs.NOFAT: A minus the fat term entirely.
rulerDefs.NOCARB: A minus the carb term entirely.
rulerDefs.Z: BOUND, NOT A PROPOSAL: kcal +-15% and protein floor ONLY. Z-A is the arithmetic ceiling of any fat/carb re-grade; 100-Z is untouchable by any of them.

denominatorDefs.planned: every planned record; unjudged + degenerate count as MISSES
denominatorDefs.satisfiable-judged: judged AND tier != IMPOSSIBLE (n=537) — the historically published one

headline.arithmeticRulerCeilingRuler: Z — kcal + protein only, fat and carb terms DELETED ENTIRELY. Not a proposal; the arithmetic bound on any fat/carb re-grade.
headline.solverIrreducibleMeaning: days that miss kcal and/or protein. NO fat/carb re-grade can ever recover them; the plan must change.
headline.nutritionallyDefensibleRuler: E35k — A's fat floor; non-keto fat ceiling re-anchored to AMDR 35%E; KETO EXEMPT; carb as A.
headline.pricedRecommendation: R35k — fat >= 0.30*lbm (the engine's own constant); non-keto fat ceiling 35%E, keto keeps A's band; carb >= max(carbLo,50); keto carb ceiling hard; no non-keto carb ceiling.
headline.statement: On n=553 (satisfiable-planned − degenerate), pooled over seeds 424242/20260730/8675309, the level is 75.11% and the gap to 100% is 24.89 pts; AT MOST 16.82 pts of that gap sit on days whose only failure is fat and/or carb (ruler Z — the arithmetic ceiling of any conceivable fat/carb re-grade), 8.08 pts sit on days that also miss kcal or protein and are untouchable by ANY ruler, and the largest NUTRITIONALLY DEFENSIBLE re-grade measures only +2.77 pts — so the RULER's recoverable share of the real gap is about +2 to +3 pts and the SOLVER owns the other ~22 pts.

doubleCountGuard.rule: A day rescued by a ruler change is NOT also available to a solver lever. Every solver lever measured under ruler A must be RE-MEASURED under whatever ruler ships.
